designs_fasta.description: Absolute path to a ProteinMPNN-format FASTA emitted by the proteinmpnn/ligandmpnn adapters. Each FASTA record's score header is parsed to rank designs before formatting as Protenix input JSONs.

top_k.description: Number of top-scoring MPNN designs to emit as Protenix input JSON files.

name_prefix.description: Filename/identifier prefix for the generated Protenix input JSONs. Output files are named `<name_prefix>_<rank>.json`.
